# coolify_application (Resource)

Manages a Coolify Application.

## Example Usage

### Docker Image Application

```terraform
resource "coolify_application" "docker_example" {
  name                       = "my-docker-app"
  project_uuid               = coolify_project.example.uuid
  server_uuid                = coolify_server.example.uuid
  environment_name           = "production"
  source_type                = "docker_image"
  docker_registry_image_name = "nginx"
  docker_registry_image_tag  = "latest"
  ports_exposes              = "80"
  instant_deploy             = true
}
```

### Public Git Application

```terraform
resource "coolify_application" "git_example" {
  name             = "my-git-app"
  project_uuid     = coolify_project.example.uuid
  server_uuid      = coolify_server.example.uuid
  environment_name = "production"
  source_type      = "public_source"
  git_repository   = "https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify-examples"
  git_branch       = "main"
  build_pack       = "nixpacks"
  ports_exposes    = "3000"
}
```

### Dockerfile Application

```terraform
resource "coolify_application" "dockerfile_example" {
  name             = "my-dockerfile-app"
  project_uuid     = coolify_project.example.uuid
  server_uuid      = coolify_server.example.uuid
  environment_name = "production"
  source_type      = "dockerfile"
  dockerfile       = "FROM nginx:alpine\nCOPY . /usr/share/nginx/html"
  ports_exposes    = "80"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `environment_name` (String) The name of the environment (e.g., 'production').
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `project_uuid` (String) The UUID of the project to deploy to.
- `server_uuid` (String) The UUID of the server to deploy to.
- `source_type` (String) The type of application source: 'docker_image', 'public_source', 'private_gh_app', 'private_deploy_key', 'dockerfile'.

### Optional

- `base_directory` (String) The base directory for the build.
- `build_command` (String) The command to build the application.
- `build_pack` (String) The build pack to use (nixpacks, static, dockerfile, dockercompose).
- `custom_docker_run_options` (String) Custom options to pass to 'docker run'.
- `custom_labels` (String) Custom labels for the container.
- `description` (String) A description of the application.
- `destination_uuid` (String) The UUID of the destination (network network).
- `docker_registry_image_name` (String) The Docker image name (required for 'docker_image').
- `docker_registry_image_tag` (String) The Docker image tag.
- `dockerfile` (String) The content of the Dockerfile (required for 'dockerfile' type).
- `domains` (String) The domains configurations for the application.
- `git_branch` (String) The Git branch to deploy from.
- `git_commit_sha` (String) The specific Git commit SHA to deploy.
- `git_repository` (String) The Git repository URL (required for git-based sources).
- `install_command` (String) The command to install dependencies.
- `instant_deploy` (Boolean) Whether to deploy instantly upon creation.
- `is_static` (Boolean) Whether the application is a static site.
- `ports_exposes` (String) Comma separated list of ports exposed by the container.
- `ports_mappings` (String) Comma separated list of port mappings (host:container).
- `private_key_uuid` (String) The UUID of the private key for private repositories.
- `start_command` (String) The command to start the application.
- `watch_paths` (String) Paths to watch for changes.

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the application.
